items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: That was the orchestra with Frank and the Pipers and Buddy Rich, Chuck, all the guys.

ctx.x: Was it hard to get, in those situations, the orchestra to swing?

Oh, there’s no such word. I was called when Joey Bushkin had problems, I was called to substitute in the Tommy Dorsey Orchestra and that was, I mean I just couldn’t believe what that was. That was the orchestra with Frank and the Pipers and Buddy Rich, Chuck, all the guys. It was the most incredible — I wouldn’t have called it — I mean there’s a difference the word dance band and orchestra, but this was ostensibly a dance band because that’s where they were playing. But the first night I went there I was…
